subject.title: Plugin install doesn't build native bindings — plugins with better-sqlite3 fail on Node 24 (ABI v137) with bindings file not found

question: Should managed npm plugin installs keep lifecycle scripts disabled and add an explicit trusted native-addon rebuild or doctor path, or should OpenClaw automatically rebuild native dependencies during install?
rationale: The observable failure is valid, but the direct fix executes untrusted package scripts and changes an intentional plugin install security boundary.

options.title: Guarded rebuild and doctor flow
options.body: Keep --ignore-scripts as the default, detect missing native artifacts or native packages, and offer an explicit trusted rebuild or doctor fix path with clear logs and tests.

options.title: Diagnostics only
options.body: Warn or fail with actionable guidance and leave rebuilds to plugin publishers or operators without adding install-time code execution to OpenClaw.

options.title: Automatic rebuild
options.body: Run npm rebuild during managed plugin install and accept broader install-time code execution for native dependency compatibility.

recommendation.title: Guarded rebuild and doctor flow
recommendation.body: Keep --ignore-scripts as the default, detect missing native artifacts or native packages, and offer an explicit trusted rebuild or doctor fix path with clear logs and tests.

likelyOwner.reason: The key history for both the plugin install surface and the script-suppression hardening points to this handle.
